Job Title: Full-Stack App Developer (Equity-Based)

Company: HiWox
Location: Remote (India) / Hybrid (Preferred: Bhubaneswar, Odisha)
Commitment: Part-Time (20-25 Hours/Week) | Founding Team | Equity-Based

About HiWox

HiWox is building a next-generation HealthTech platform focused on preventive healthcare, AI-powered health intelligence, and holistic wellness through the 9 Dimensions of Wellness.

We are not building just another healthcare application.

Our vision is to create an integrated ecosystem that combines healthcare professionals, diagnostics, wearable devices, AI, and personalized wellness programs to help individuals and organizations achieve measurable health outcomes.

As a Full-Stack App Developer, you will be responsible for building and scaling the core technology powering the HiWox ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities Full-Stack Development

Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
Build secure backend services, REST APIs, databases, authentication systems, and cloud infrastructure.
Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code while following best engineering practices.

Product Development

Develop core product modules including user onboarding, Digital Health Index (DHI), wellness assessments, consultant dashboards, employer dashboards, appointments, chat, notifications, payments, reports, and progress tracking.
Integrate third-party services including wearable devices, healthcare APIs, payment gateways, video consultation, WhatsApp, maps, and AI services.
Work closely with UI/UX designers to create intuitive and responsive user experiences.

AI Scalable Architecture

Collaborate with AI and data science teams to integrate intelligent recommendations, automation, and predictive healthcare features.
Design scalable application architecture capable of supporting future product expansion and enterprise deployments.
Optimize application performance, reliability, and security.

Collaboration Engineering Excellence

Work with product managers, designers, healthcare professionals, and business teams to convert requirements into scalable software.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, testing, documentation, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
Continuously improve development processes, coding standards, and system reliability.

Who Should Apply

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
2-6+ years of experience in full-stack application development.
Strong understanding of scalable system architecture, API development, cloud technologies, and database design.
Passion for building impactful HealthTech products.

Preferred Skills

React.js / Next.js
React Native (Preferred)
Node.js / Python / Java
REST APIs GraphQL
PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
Firebase
AWS / GCP
Git CI/CD
Docker
AI API Integrations
Healthcare Data Security

Immediate Priorities (First 90 Days)

Build and optimize the HiWox mobile and web applications.
Develop scalable APIs and backend services.
Complete core healthcare workflows and dashboard modules.
Integrate AI features and third-party healthcare services.
Improve application performance, security, and scalability.
Support product launch and future feature development.

What Youll Gain

Become a founding member of an innovative HealthTech startup.
Equity ownership with long-term wealth creation potential.
Work directly with the founder to build the companys core technology.
Gain experience in AI-powered healthcare, scalable product development, and startup execution.
Help create one of Indias leading preventive healthcare platforms.

Equity-Based Opportunity

This is an equity-only founding team role.

There is no fixed salary during the initial bootstrapping phase. Compensation will be introduced after fundraising and revenue stabilization.

Our onboarding process includes:

3-4 strategic discussions with the founder.
A 1-month NDA-based collaboration phase to evaluate technical capability, execution, ownership, and long-term alignment.
Long-term founding team agreement.
Equity allocation based on contribution and commitment.
A 5-year vesting structure for all core founding members.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

Has experience building and deploying complete web and mobile applications.
Can independently architect scalable systems and solve complex engineering problems.
Has strong knowledge of backend development, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks.
Is passionate about AI, HealthTech, and building products from the ground up.
Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a strong ownership mindset.
Bonus if you have experience in HealthTech, Telemedicine, React Native, AWS, Firebase, AI integrations, or healthcare applications.

Were Looking For

We are not looking for someone who simply develops application features.

We are looking for a founding Full-Stack App Developer who can build scalable digital products, architect robust systems, integrate AI-driven capabilities, and lay the technology foundation for one of Indias most advanced preventive healthcare platforms.

Senior Staff Engineer AI & Agentic Engineering




Location: India (Flexible — WFO preferred, otherwise 2 quarterly visits are compulsory)




The Role

As Senior Staff Engineer, you'll be one of the senior-most individual contributors driving that shift from the engineering side — turning "we should use AI here" into working, production systems. This is not a role where the product hands you a spec. You'll often be the one deciding what's worth building before anyone else has framed the problem.




Your core mandate is threefold:

Build agentic capability into the core platform. Design and ship AI/agent-driven features — autonomous workflows, decision engines, LLM-integrated tooling — into a commerce platform already processing billions in transaction volume.
Operate at the edge of ambiguity. Take a rough direction, not a groomed backlog, and turn it into a scoped, shippable plan yourself. You'll be trusted to define the "what" as much as the "how."
Set the technical bar for how we build with AI. You won't be the only engineer touching this space — you'll help shape the standard others follow.



What You'll Walk Into

An agentic initiative already underway — early proof-of-concept work has shipped, momentum exists, but there's no dedicated senior technical owner driving it end-to-end yet
A production platform with deep integrations across QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and more — technically complex and high-stakes
Owning distinct areas of the platform — you'll have real IC peers at your level, not just reports
A manager who will be a technical thought partner, not a filter — you'll engage directly with architecture and roadmap decisions, not through a PM layer



What You'll Do

Agentic Product Development

Design and build AI/agent-driven features across the commerce platform — from proof-of-concept to production
Own ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems end-to-end without waiting on a fully-groomed spec

Technical Ownership & Craft

Make and defend architecture calls independently; bring options with tradeoffs, not open-ended questions
Partner with our architecture function on how agentic systems integrate cleanly into the existing platform layer, rather than bypassing it

Roadmap & Direction

Partner with engineering and product leadership on what to build, not just receive requirements — shape the roadmap, don't just consume it
Identify where AI creates real leverage for customers (vs. where it's just a buzzword) and make the case for it

Cross-Functional Leadership

Set technical direction for others working in the agentic space; raise the bar on how the team builds with AI
Communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders



What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

8+ years in backend/systems engineering, with real production experience owning complex systems end-to-end
Hands-on fluency with AI/LLM tooling — you've built with agents, RAG, tool-calling, or similar, not just used ChatGPT
Demonstrated comfort operating without a fully-defined spec — a track record of shaping a fuzzy problem into a concrete, shippable plan
Strong, independent architectural judgment — comfortable defending a design decision under scrutiny
Self-directed — you don't need a product manager to break down the work before you can start
Clear communicator — can explain a technical decision and its tradeoffs to both engineers and leadership



Strong advantages:

Experience with .NET / C# (our core stack)
Prior experience in a startup or small-team environment where you owned ambiguity by necessity, not choice
Exposure to e-commerce, ERP, or integration-heavy platforms



Why Join Webgility

Real impact: Your work directly shapes how thousands of small businesses operate, not just how data moves between systems
Builder's role: You're defining Webgility's agentic capability, not maintaining an established roadmap someone else set
Domain depth: Ecommerce + accounting is a complex, high-stakes integration problem with a large TAM
Direct access: You'll work closely with engineering leadership on architecture and direction, with real influence over what gets built next



Webgility is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
